description: Get or set Do Not Disturb / Focus mode. The get action is best-effort — macOS 13+ protects the Focus state database and the returned status may be "unknown" on some configurations. The set action requires the built-in "Set Focus" shortcut to exist in the Shortcuts app (present on macOS 12+). Mode names must exactly match configured Focus profiles (e.g. "Do Not Disturb", "Work", "Personal").

action.description: get — query current Focus status (best-effort); set — enable or disable a Focus mode.

enabled.description: For action=set: true=enable the mode, false=disable it. Defaults to true.

mode.description: Focus mode name for action=set, e.g. "Do Not Disturb", "Work". Must match a configured Focus profile exactly.

name: macos_manage_focus

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `shortcuts_unavailable`: The shortcuts CLI is not available or the "Set Focus" shortcut does not exist. `focus_not_found`: The provided mode name does not match any known Focus profile. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mode.description: Active Focus mode name, or null when inactive or unknown. Present for action=get and action=set.

reason.description: Explanation when status is "unknown". Present for action=get.

status.description: Current Focus status. Present for action=get. "unknown" when macOS cannot be queried without entitlements.

success.description: True when the Focus mode was applied. Present for action=set.

title: Manage macOS Focus Mode
